name: IC Interface USB — USB — TSSOP
description: Surface-mount USB interface IC cluster with 2 tier A parts utilizing TSSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm and TSSOP-16_4.4x5mm_P0.65mm footprints.
selection_hints: A surface-mount USB interface IC in a TSSOP package is required.
Layout requires TSSOP-10 (3x3mm, 0.5mm pitch) or TSSOP-16 (4.4x5mm, 0.65mm pitch) footprints.
Choosing tier A parts such as TS3USB30EDGSR or IP2721.
avoid_when: Design requires package families other than TSSOP.
Layout requires through-hole mounting instead of SMD.
Footprints other than TSSOP-10 3x3mm or TSSOP-16 4.4x5mm are needed.
